text:
Type: small metal cabinet with door
Use: storing small things on the floor, a shelf or a wall; living room, home office, hallway
Style: retro, industrial, contemporary
Materials: powder-coated steel, metal door with a small tab pull
Colors: bright azure blue
Shape: cube-shaped box with one flush hinged door, tiny tab handle, crisp square edges, small feet, compact and stackable
Feel: bold, playful, fresh, practical
Goes with: white walls, light wood, other bright colors, black accents; retro, industrial or playful modern rooms

product.name: LIXHULT
product.description: Helps you keep track of small items like chargers, keys and wallets, or more bulky items like handbags and toys. It all depends on which of the 3 cabinet sizes you choose.
